# Pitch numbers (generated by scripts/pitch_numbers.py; do not edit by hand)

Every number comes from web/public/data, the same files the app loads: hourly samples, the centre of the Sun or Earth above the terrain horizon, observer 2 m above the ground. Checks against JPL and NASA: docs/VALIDATION.md.

## 4. When can a 14-day mission land at Malapert Massif (mma01)?

Mission: 336 h on the surface, at least 70 % sunlit, at least 50 % Earth visible, no darkness longer than 48 h, Sun and Earth both up at touchdown. Same rule as the app's Window Finder; a day counts if any landing hour that UTC day works.

- Period searched: 2026-11-14 to 2027-11-13 (365 days).
- **Days that work: 32 of 365** (473 landing hours), in 13 clusters.
- Longest cluster: 3 days. Longest gap between clusters: 28 days.

| Cluster | First day | Last day | Days |
|--------:|-----------|----------|-----:|
| 1 | 2026-11-17 | 2026-11-19 | 3 |
| 2 | 2026-12-17 | 2026-12-19 | 3 |
| 3 | 2027-01-15 | 2027-01-17 | 3 |
